title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully merged and deduplicated museum_export_a.csv and museum_export_b.csv. Cleaned accession numbers to identify 24 unique objects from the initial 70 rows. Categorized the objects into historical time periods based on their notes and generated a bar chart visualizing this distribution. The final report and the visualization have been saved to the report directory.
